mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_history (thread_id, role, content, source_doc, heading_path, create_time) VALUES (#{threadId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{sourceDoc}, #{headingPath}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (thread_id) * FROM chat_history ORDER BY thread_id, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_history SET rating = #{rating} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(content) AS query, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chat_history WHERE role = 'user' GROUP BY TRIM(content) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_assistant, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 END), 0) AS thumbs_up, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN rating = -1 THEN 1 END), 0) AS thumbs_down, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN rating IS NULL THEN 1 END), 0) AS unrated, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 END), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN rating IN (1, -1) THEN 1 END), 0), 1) AS satisfaction_rate FROM chat_history WHERE role = 'assistant'

SELECT TO_CHAR(d.date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ch.rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS thumbs_up, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ch.rating = -1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS thumbs_down, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ch.rating IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unrated, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ch.rating = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN ch.rating IN (1, -1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1) AS satisfaction_rate FROM generate_series(CURRENT_DATE - (#{days} - 1), CURRENT_DATE, '1 day'::interval) d(date) LEFT JOIN chat_history ch ON DATE(ch.create_time) = d.date AND ch.role = 'assistant' GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date

WITH paired AS ( SELECT id, thread_id, role, content, source_doc, heading_path, create_time, rating, LAG(role) OVER (PARTITION BY thread_id ORDER BY create_time ASC) AS prev_role, LAG(content) OVER (PARTITION BY thread_id ORDER BY create_time ASC) AS prev_content FROM chat_history ) SELECT p.id, p.thread_id AS thread_id, p.prev_content AS user_question, LEFT(p.content, 200) AS assistant_answer_excerpt, p.content AS assistant_answer_full, p.source_doc AS source_doc, p.heading_path AS heading_path, p.create_time AS create_time, p.rating FROM paired p WHERE p.role = 'assistant' AND p.rating = -1 AND p.prev_role = 'user' ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT source_doc, heading_path, COUNT(*) AS negative_count, MAX(create_time) AS last_occurrence FROM chat_history WHERE role = 'assistant' AND rating = -1 AND source_doc IS NOT NULL AND source_doc != '' GROUP BY source_doc, heading_path ORDER BY negative_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT cu.department, COUNT(*) AS total_rated, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN ch.rating = 1 THEN 1 END), 0) AS thumbs_up, COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN ch.rating = -1 THEN 1 END), 0) AS thumbs_down, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN ch.rating = 1 THEN 1 END), 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN ch.rating IN (1, -1) THEN 1 END), 0), 1) AS satisfaction_rate FROM chat_history ch JOIN chat_session cs ON ch.thread_id = cs.thread_id JOIN chat_user cu ON cs.user_id = cu.id WHERE ch.role = 'assistant' AND cu.department IS NOT NULL AND cu.department != '' GROUP BY cu.department ORDER BY total_rated DESC
